race.comment: NATIONAL ASSET (3) has scored well at his last two starts, most recently over this trip at Narrandera when storming from the back. Expect him to drift back again from the draw and be charging late. TOMMY FLYER (1) is going better than his form reads and now steps out to a winning trip on the short turnaround. Gets an important 4kg claim and should be able to give backers a sight. SUNDROP (7) chased hard to just miss two back at Narrendera. Less effective last time but she has run well here in the past and has the peaks to measure up. MISHIMA (12) led pillar to post to score at big odds last time in the testing conditions. Worth following up.
